events.verdict: Dinwiddie (DAL) briefly engages with Bane (MEM) as he attempts to defend over the screen.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) releases away from the pick and the contact with Dinwiddie (DAL) is marginal.
Dinwiddie (DAL) rests a forearm against Bane (MEM) and the contact does not cause him to lose control of his dribble.
Lively II (DAL) initiates contact with Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) arm, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Bane (MEM) places his hands against Irving's (DAL) back with slight extension, but the contact during the rebound is marginal.
Bane (MEM) briefly places a hand to Irving's (DAL) front but the contact does not affect his SQBR.
Bane (MEM) contests Irving's (DAL) jump shot and the contact after the release, and follow-through, is marginal.
Lively II (DAL) and Aldama (MEM) engage during the rebound.
Smart (MEM) leans his head into Doncic's (DAL) shoulder and the contact is incidental as Doncic makes a normal basketball move to start his drive.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) firms up in a screening position in Grimes' (DAL) path and the contact is marginal.
Washington (DAL) legally contests Morant's (MEM) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Aldama (MEM) commits a take foul on Irving (DAL). The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Doncic (DAL) closes out to the side as he contests Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) jump shot and makes "high-five" contact with Jackson Jr.'s left hand after the ball is released.
Dinwiddie (DAL) legally contests Morant's (MEM) jump shot attempt.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) commits a take foul on Doncic (DAL).
